card.title: Warmly Withholding
card.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your school meeting went fine, love. The headteacher and I discussed your suspension. Have some tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A little while. I'll be home with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will I miss the school play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Oh, sweetheart. Come sit beside me. You don't have to face this alone.

mechanism: A replaces increasingly specific answers about a suspension with progressively less informative affection.
confusable: Unlike blunt secrecy, reassurance must stay warm while the amount of disclosed information diminishes.
comparison: Parental comfort obscures a child's school consequences; the dress scene substitutes customer care for delivery access.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
